alkylation reagent: resuspended in 240ul of reducing and alkylating buffer (8M urea, 10mM TCEP, 40mM CAA, 100mM Tris pH 8)
alkylation concentration: resuspended in 240ul of reducing and alkylating buffer (8M urea, 10mM TCEP, 40mM CAA, 100mM Tris pH 8)
cleavage agent: proteins were extracted, denatured, and digested with trypsin
collision energy: Selected precursors were fragmented using a normalized collision energy level of 30
fractionation method: Digested peptides were then fractionated using high-pH reverse-phase liquid chromatography
instrument: analyzed on a Thermo Orbitrap Fusion Lumos
ionization type: Eluting peptide fragments were ionized by electrospray ionization
labeling: Spectra were searched using fast LFQ against a full human proteome
reduction reagent: resuspended in 240ul of reducing and alkylating buffer (8M urea, 10mM TCEP, 40mM CAA, 100mM Tris pH 8)
reduction concentration: resuspended in 240ul of reducing and alkylating buffer (8M urea, 10mM TCEP, 40mM CAA, 100mM Tris pH 8)
